newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen higher after polls, big-caps.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen higher after polls, big-caps.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be higher on Friday following the completion of voting in the general election on Thursday with no major incidents reported on main Java island, brokers said.

"Although some investors remain concerned over political stability, the fact is that yesterday' general election was done without any major incidents. Investors are regaining their confidence," one broker with European securities said.
She said both foreign and domestic investors might snap up blue chips and small stocks, with first-quarter results boosting market sentiment.
